SS2/26 – High loan to income lending

Supervisory statement 2/26

Effective from 28 October 2026.

First published on 14 October 2026. 

Following PS19/26 – High loan to income lending.

Contents

    1: Introduction

    1.1 This supervisory statement (SS) is relevant to all firms in scope of the Housing Part of the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) Rulebook.

    1.2 This statement sets out the PRA’s expectations for firms entering into high loan to income (LTI) mortgages.footnote [1] This SS should be read in conjunction with the requirements in the Housing Part.

    Footnotes

    • For the example firm, the most recent measure of its high LTI flow is 17.5%.

    ‘High LTI mortgage contract’ is defined in the Housing Part of the PRA Rulebook.
